method: Real HTTP and MongoDB in a unique disposable database; local pedagogical AI fallback

checks.name: Teacher login accepts the demo credentials and rejects the wrong password
Schedule and content contain only the assigned class
Lesson preview has real local pictures; sentence screen falls back to the Unit
Homework is unavailable before there is any evidence of learning
Planner creates a 25 minute pedagogical plan, even with generative AI unavailable
Prepare attendance, retain duration and plan, then start one live classroom
Live scoring rejects absence and deduplicates repeated clicks
Observation saved from the session also appears in the Unit overview
Closing validates objectives, advances class curriculum once and freezes live scoring
Teacher assigns one homework activity and the child receives that same assignment
Child submits the real activity; teacher reviews it and family reads the feedback
Family report uses evidence and assigned homework; retries do not duplicate delivery
All remaining teacher destinations load their real data and absent/no-data children stay distinct
Private notes can be created, edited and removed without sending a family message
Cancelling homework removes it from current work while keeping submission history
